rule: A reviewed MCQ letter correction (src/data/reviewed-mcq-answer-letters.json, an entry with a note) also applies when a whole paper is self-marked: the marking list and report show the corrected letter beside the published one, with its source. Each erratum is bound to the exact mark-scheme PDF the archive serves for that paper. The original PDF is never changed.
